integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically from the full automorphism form and a complete five-stratum count in GL_2 over an arbitrary finite field. Exhaustive computations for q=2,3,4,5,7 are stress checks only. The prior fixed-point-free formula is explicitly credited. Same-object automorphism literature was inspected at statement level, including Liu--Tang (2018). Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra. The fixed-point-free fiber is already published and is included only as one part of the complete spectrum. No claim is made for higher-dimensional Heisenberg algebras. Literature comparison was bounded; the closest same-object automorphism-group article was inspected and does not contain finite-field fixed-space enumeration.
title: Complete fixed-space spectrum of automorphisms of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra
